thanks.title: Mèsi and Mèsi anpil
thanks.bodyMarkdown:
**Mèsi** means “thank you.” To make the thanks stronger, say **Mèsi anpil** — “thank you very much.”

Both are complete, useful expressions you can use immediately.

please.title: Tanpri
please.bodyMarkdown:
**Tanpri** means “please.” It is useful when making a polite request.

At this stage, practice recognizing the word and placing it naturally with other short expressions.

excuse.title: Padon
excuse.bodyMarkdown:
**Padon** can be used for “pardon” or “excuse me” in simple situations.

These small polite words matter because they make even very short conversations feel complete and respectful.
